detail:
The creator says that regular, scheduled sleep mattered more to them than how many total hours they slept. They explain that daytime naps did not fix the effects of staying up until 3 or 4 AM, and that keeping the same bedtime and wake time every day helped with their insomnia and adrenaline dumps.

The creator personally uses melatonin to fall asleep. This is their own routine, not a recommendation: talk to your doctor before trying any sleep aid, since sleep aids can interact with other conditions and medications.

Tabs is not endorsing or verifying this material. Talk to your doctor about sleep problems.
sourceVideoTitle: Tips I wish someone told me sooner as a young adult living with POTS and MCAS
summary: The creator says keeping the same bedtime and wake time every day helped their insomnia and adrenaline dumps, and mattered more than total sleep hours.
takeaways: go to bed and wake up at the same time every day
for the creator, steady timing mattered more than total hours
naps did not fix staying up until 3 or 4 in the morning
title: Keeping a regular sleep schedule
